supplements.title: Astragaloside IV targets TUBB4B to inhibit proliferation and promote apoptosis of pituitary tumor cells via the STMN1/ERK pathway.
supplements.summary: Astragaloside IV, a compound from traditional Chinese medicine, stops pituitary tumor growth by targeting a protein called TUBB4B.

supplements.title: Combining bioinformatics prediction with experimental validation to explore the ameliorative effect of Psoralea corylifolia on vitiligo.
supplements.summary: Psoralea corylifolia plant extracts increase melanin production in vitiligo through multiple active ingredients targeting apoptosis and PI3K/Akt pathways.

supplements.title: Inhibiting FGFR by toadflax reverses erlotinib resistance in nonsmall cell lung cancer.
supplements.summary: Bufalin reverses erlotinib resistance in lung cancer by blocking FGFR, restoring drug effectiveness when combined with erlotinib.

supplements.title: Anti-hepatocellular carcinoma activity of Jacaranda mimosifolia through experimental validation and network pharmacology.
supplements.summary: Jacaranda mimosifolia extract inhibits hepatocellular carcinoma cell growth and triggers cancer cell death through multiple molecular pathways.

supplements.title: Study on material basis and network mechanism of the Guizhi Fuling pills in the treatment of endometriosis and endometrial polyps.
supplements.summary: Guizhi Fuling pills treat endometriosis and endometrial polyps through compounds like luteolin and quercetin, targeting inflammation and estrogen pathways.

supplements.title: Weighing the risk: a scoping review on the relationship between obesity and glioma.
supplements.summary: Obesity's link to glioma risk varies by age, gender, and body composition, with early-life weight and lifestyle factors playing significant roles.

supplements.title: Limosilactobacillus reuteri metabolites modulate immune pathways and intestinal barrier repair after 5 fluorouracil exposure.
supplements.summary: Probiotic bacterial metabolites help repair gut damage and reduce inflammation caused by the chemotherapy drug 5-fluorouracil.

supplements.title: Probiotic novel strain Lactobacillus reuteri MRD01 alleviates dextran sulfate sodium-induced colitis in male mice by promoting intestinal barrier integrity.
supplements.summary: A new probiotic strain alleviates colitis in mice by strengthening the intestinal barrier and reducing inflammation.

supplements.title: Isolation and First Total Synthesis of PM100618 and PM110049, Two Structurally Distinct Marine-Derived Anticancer Oxazole Derivatives.
supplements.summary: Researchers synthesized two powerful cancer-fighting compounds from a marine sponge, enabling future drug development studies.

supplements.title: Effects of dietary glycerol monodecanoate supplementation on inflammation, oxidative stress, ghrelin acylation, and gastrointestinal transcriptome in Yanbian cattle fed a high-concentrate diet.
supplements.summary: Glycerol monodecanoate supplement reduced inflammation and oxidative stress in cattle fed high-grain diets.

supplements.title: LC-ESI-MS/MS targeted phenolic profiling, antioxidant, anticholinesterase and cytotoxic activities of ethyl acetate and n-butanol fractions of Hypericum pubescens Boiss.
supplements.summary: Hypericum pubescens extracts showed strong antioxidant and brain enzyme-inhibiting properties, but lacked cytotoxic effects against colorectal, ovarian, and glioblastoma cancer cells.

supplements.title: Protective Effects of p-Coumaric Acid Against Paclitaxel-Induced Testicular Damage: Role of Oxidative Stress, Inflammation, Apoptosis, and Autophagy.
supplements.summary: P-coumaric acid protects against cancer drug paclitaxel-induced testicular damage by reducing oxidative stress and inflammation.

supplements.title: Sulforaphane Synergizes With PD-1 Blockade Through Activating CD8+ T Cells in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer: Preclinical and Clinical Investigations.
supplements.summary: Sulforaphane combined with immunotherapy and chemotherapy improved lung cancer treatment outcomes by boosting immune cell activity.

supplements.title: A hypothesis on restoring neuronal membrane potential in dementia: early hit identification of 4-IPBA as a potential ion-channel modulator.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified 4-IPBA, a natural compound, as a potential treatment to restore brain cell ion channel function and protect against dementia-related cognitive decline.

supplements.title: Metal-Organic Framework DNA Hydrogel Microspheres Enable Ferroptosis-Based Therapy for Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a nanoparticle system delivering curcumin and cisplatin that triggers ferroptosis to effectively treat esophageal squamous cell carcinoma with minimal toxicity.

off_label.title: Everolimus destabilizes thymidylate synthase via suppressing its O-GlcNAcylation and sensitizes HER2-negative breast cancer to fluorouracil.
off_label.summary: Everolimus enhances fluorouracil effectiveness in HER2-negative breast cancer by destabilizing a key drug target protein.

off_label.title: Nationwide survey of ruxolitinib administration for Japanese children with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.
off_label.summary: Ruxolitinib showed high response rates in Japanese children with treatment-resistant hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, offering a promising new therapy option.

off_label.title: Atorvastatin-Driven Methuosis in Glioblastoma: A Biomimetic Nanodrug for Targeted Tumor Therapy.
off_label.summary: Atorvastatin nanoparticles designed to cross the brain-blood barrier effectively kill glioblastoma cells and boost immune response.

off_label.title: Systemic glucocorticoid use and risk of site-specific cancers: a methodological systematic review of observational studies.
off_label.summary: Observational studies on glucocorticoids and cancer risk have significant methodological flaws, with inconsistent findings except for possible non-Hodgkin lymphoma associations.

off_label.title: Glucocorticoid-Induced Proteome and Phosphoproteome Changes in Breast Cancer Cell Lines.
off_label.summary: Dexamethasone, a steroid given with breast cancer chemotherapy, alters proteins that promote cell migration and metastasis through glucocorticoid receptor signaling.

off_label.title: Thoracic endometriosis in an inoperable patient.
off_label.summary: Woman with lung endometriosis treated with hormone therapy when surgery wasn't possible; condition remained stable with complications.

off_label.title: GLP-1 receptor agonists and immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy: a narrative review on mechanistic and clinical evidence.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 drugs may enhance cancer immunotherapy effectiveness by reprogramming the immune system, showing improved survival in multiple cancer types.

off_label.title: Statin Therapy to Reduce Disease Progression From Liver Cirrhosis to Cancer
off_label.summary: Simvastatin may prevent liver cancer development in cirrhosis patients by blocking enzymes that promote cancer cell growth.

off_label.title: GCL-MSE: Graph Contrastive Learning with Mutual Similarity Enhancement for Drug Repositioning.
off_label.summary: A new AI method identifies existing drugs for cancer and other diseases by analyzing drug and disease relationships, predicting treatments like hydroxyurea for breast cancer.

off_label.title: Statins and postmenopausal breast cancer risk; results from the KARMA cohort.
off_label.summary: Statin use in postmenopausal women showed no significant protective effect against breast cancer in a Swedish study.

off_label.title: Safety concerns associated with various types of statins: a disproportionality analysis of the FAERS database.
off_label.summary: Researchers analyzed statin side effects to compare safety profiles across different types and improve patient treatment decisions.

off_label.title: Statins targeting mevalonate-geranylgeranyl diphosphate pathway inhibit proliferation in NK/T lymphoma by promoting pyroptosis.
off_label.summary: Statins kill NK/T cell lymphoma cancer cells by triggering pyroptosis, a type of inflammatory cell death, offering a potential new treatment approach.

off_label.title: Beyond Antiviral Therapy: Untapped Potential of HIV & HCV Protease Inhibitors.
off_label.summary: HIV and HCV protease inhibitors show promise as repurposed cancer drugs due to their unique ability to target difficult protein sites.

off_label.title: Sacubitril/Valsartan and Prevention of Chemotherapy-Induced Cardiac Dysfunction: Meta-analysis of Randomized Trials.
off_label.summary: Sacubitril/valsartan preserves heart function during chemotherapy but doesn't yet reduce cardiac dysfunction or death rates.

off_label.title: Targeted Therapies in Infantile Hemangiomas and Vascular Malformations: From β-Blockers to PI3K/AKT/mTOR Inhibitors.
off_label.summary: Propranolol and newer targeted drugs like sirolimus effectively treat infantile hemangiomas and vascular malformations by blocking specific disease-causing genetic pathways.

biomarkers.title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of tepotinib vs capmatinib as subsequent therapy in MET exon 14-mutated non-small-cell lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Tepotinib proves more cost-effective than capmatinib for treating advanced lung cancer with specific MET mutations in China.

biomarkers.title: T cell fate regulation in EBV‑associated nasopharyngeal carcinoma (Review).
biomarkers.summary: T cells become exhausted in nasopharyngeal carcinoma, helping the virus-linked cancer evade immune attack and suggesting new treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: The heart of the matter: a personal view of Fred Wittinghofer's contributions to RAS biology and drug design.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered how RAS proteins work, enabling development of drugs to treat RAS-driven cancers by blocking cancer cell growth signals.

biomarkers.title: A PI3Kδ-Foxo1-FasL signaling amplification loop rewires CD4+ T cell signaling and differentiation.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered that blocking a death pathway protein (FasL) restores normal immune cell development disrupted by PI3K mutations.

biomarkers.title: NMDA-receptor blockade changed microRNAs expression and apoptotic gene levels in dorsolateral striatal glioblastoma to reduce tumor growth and reverse behavioral impairments in rats.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking NMDA receptors in glioblastoma shrinks tumors and restores normal behavior by increasing cancer cell death genes.

biomarkers.title: Multi-omics analysis identified SPRR2D as a potential biomarker for tumor prognosis and immune microenvironment infiltration: a pan-cancer perspective.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified SPRR2D as a potential cancer biomarker that could help predict patient outcomes and immune cell activity across multiple cancer types.

biomarkers.title: N-terphenylpicolinamide derivatives designed to target PD-L1 increase activation and proliferation of T cells, and their cytotoxic properties toward cancer cells.
biomarkers.summary: New molecules blocking PD-L1 protein reactivate immune cells to kill cancer more effectively.

biomarkers.title: Everolimus destabilizes thymidylate synthase via suppressing its O-GlcNAcylation and sensitizes HER2-negative breast cancer to fluorouracil.
biomarkers.summary: Everolimus enhances fluorouracil effectiveness in HER2-negative breast cancer by destabilizing a key drug target protein.

biomarkers.title: Orthotopic Esophageal Cancer Xenograft Model in Immunosuppressed Microminipigs for Near-Infrared Fluorescence Endoscopy.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a fluorescent antibody technique and animal model to detect hard-to-see esophageal cancer earlier using special endoscopy imaging.

biomarkers.title: Cancer pain: current practice and emerging targets.
biomarkers.summary: Cancer pain involves complex interactions between tumors and their environment; emerging personalized therapies targeting specific pain mechanisms offer alternatives to traditional NSAIDs and opioids.

biomarkers.title: Atorvastatin-Driven Methuosis in Glioblastoma: A Biomimetic Nanodrug for Targeted Tumor Therapy.
biomarkers.summary: Atorvastatin nanoparticles designed to cross the brain-blood barrier effectively kill glioblastoma cells and boost immune response.

biomarkers.title: INAEME: Integral Neoantigen Analysis with Entirety of Mutational Events
biomarkers.summary: INAEME is a new tool that accurately identifies cancer cell neoantigens for immunotherapy by analyzing all types of genetic mutations, not just some.

biomarkers.title: Sialic acid cis-ligand dynamics modulate Siglec-7 and -9 function and affect Siglec-7/9 co-blockade to potentiate natural killer cell anti-tumor activity.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking both Siglec-7 and Siglec-9 together enhances natural killer cells' ability to kill melanoma and leukemia cells more effectively than blocking either alone.

biomarkers.title: Astragaloside IV targets TUBB4B to inhibit proliferation and promote apoptosis of pituitary tumor cells via the STMN1/ERK pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Astragaloside IV, a compound from traditional Chinese medicine, stops pituitary tumor growth by targeting a protein called TUBB4B.

biomarkers.title: Mechanism of and research progress on alterations in the RET gene in thyroid cancer (Review).
biomarkers.summary: RET gene mutations and fusions drive the development of medullary and papillary thyroid cancers, making it a key treatment target.

trials.title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of tepotinib vs capmatinib as subsequent therapy in MET exon 14-mutated non-small-cell lung cancer.
trials.summary: Tepotinib proves more cost-effective than capmatinib for treating advanced lung cancer with specific MET mutations in China.

trials.title: Protocol flexibility in PCOS: a combination of controlled ovarian stimulation and endometrial preparation strategies shows no impact on live birth outcomes after frozen embryo transfer-a retrospective cohort study.
trials.summary: Different hormone treatment combinations for PCOS patients undergoing fertility treatment produce similar pregnancy success rates.

trials.title: Everolimus destabilizes thymidylate synthase via suppressing its O-GlcNAcylation and sensitizes HER2-negative breast cancer to fluorouracil.
trials.summary: Everolimus enhances fluorouracil effectiveness in HER2-negative breast cancer by destabilizing a key drug target protein.

trials.title: Nationwide survey of ruxolitinib administration for Japanese children with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.
trials.summary: Ruxolitinib showed high response rates in Japanese children with treatment-resistant hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, offering a promising new therapy option.

trials.title: Hematopoietic progenitor kinase 1 inhibitor BGB-15025 induces apoptosis in acute myeloid leukemia cells through the cell cycle pathway and mitogen-activated protein kinase/extracellular signal-regulated kinase pathway signaling axis.
trials.summary: BGB-15025, a new drug, kills acute myeloid leukemia cells by blocking cell cycle progression and disrupting cancer-promoting signaling pathways.

trials.title: Coassembled Prodrug Nanoparticles Mitigating the Acquired Resistance to Protein Degradation Therapy.
trials.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles combining cancer-fighting PROTACs with rapamycin to overcome drug resistance in breast cancer cells.

trials.title: Regulation of mitochondrial ROS by C15ORF48 in a basal cell subpopulation contributes to chemotherapy resistance in TNBC.
trials.summary: A protein called C15ORF48 in triple negative breast cancer cells reduces chemotherapy damage by lowering reactive oxygen species, enabling drug resistance.

trials.title: Anti-cancer effect of a novel photodynamic therapy using glucose-linked chlorin e6 conjugated trastuzumab for HER2-positive gastrointestinal cancers.
trials.summary: A new photodynamic therapy using antibody-linked light-activating molecules selectively targets and kills HER2-positive gastrointestinal cancer cells.

trials.title: Utilizing the transformer mechanism to predict cervical lymph node metastasis in patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma.
trials.summary: Researchers used artificial intelligence to predict which papillary thyroid cancer patients have spread to neck lymph nodes before surgery.

trials.title: Glucocorticoid Receptor Antagonist Approved for Ovarian Cancer.
trials.summary: A new drug called relacorilant improves survival in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer when combined with chemotherapy.

trials.title: PRognostic and predictive potential Of multiparametric dynamic whole-body 18F-FDG PET Imaging using a Long axial field-of-view (LAFOV) system for FIRST-line chemo-immunotherapy efficacy in advanced non-small cell lung cancer: PROFIL-1 study protocol.
trials.summary: Study tests whether advanced PET imaging can predict which lung cancer patients benefit from chemotherapy-immunotherapy combination treatment.

trials.title: In-House Advanced 3D Printing Enhances TMJ Surgical Planning: The 10-Year Evolution of the Mayo Clinic Experience.
trials.summary: 3D printing models improved surgical planning and outcomes for complex temporomandibular joint cases over ten years at Mayo Clinic.

trials.title: Post-marketing signal detection of fruquintinib-associated adverse events using the FAERS database.
trials.summary: Fruquintinib for colorectal cancer shows expected safety concerns including diarrhea, nausea, and bone marrow suppression in real-world use.

trials.title: Evaluation of adverse event profiles for leuprolide and goserelin: Insights from the FDA adverse event reporting system following STROBE guidelines.
trials.summary: Leuprolide and goserelin, used for hormone-dependent cancers, show distinct safety profiles, with leuprolide linked to reproductive and cancer-related side effects and goserelin to endocrine disorders.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of mindfulness-based stress reduction in managing fatigue, anxiety, and depression among non-small cell lung cancer patients receiving surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy: A randomized controlled trial.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based stress reduction helped reduce fatigue, anxiety, and depression in lung cancer patients undergoing surgery and chemotherapy.

mind_body.title: Prevalence and severity of imposter phenomenon in consultant radiographers.
mind_body.summary: Study finds self-doubt feelings are common among consultant radiographers despite their proven competence and expertise.

mind_body.title: Electroacupuncture improves cognitive function and neuropsychiatric symptoms in breast cancer survivors: a pilot randomized controlled trial.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture treatment improved cognitive function and mental health symptoms in breast cancer survivors in a pilot study.

mind_body.title: Supportive Care Interventions in Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Supportive care interventions like exercise, music, and stress management show promise for improving quality of life in blood cancer patients undergoing stem cell transplants.

mind_body.title: The Effect of Yoga and Relaxation Techniques on Anxiety, Stress Levels, and Quality of Life in Parents of Children Diagnosed with Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Yoga and relaxation techniques significantly improve anxiety, stress, and quality of life in parents caring for children with cancer.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness and Safety of Acupuncture for Cancer-Related Cognitive Impairment: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may help improve thinking and memory problems caused by cancer and its treatments, though more rigorous research is needed.

mind_body.title: Music therapy interventions on symptom management in adults with advanced cancer - multisession longitudinal impact: systematic review.
mind_body.summary: Music therapy sessions may help reduce symptoms and improve quality of life in adults with advanced cancer receiving end-of-life care.

mind_body.title: Consensus Recommendations for Disease- and Treatment-Related Fatigue in Patients With Advanced Prostate Cancer: A Modified Delphi Panel.
mind_body.summary: Experts created guidelines to help doctors and advanced prostate cancer patients manage fatigue together through shared decision-making.

mind_body.title: Electroacupuncture Enhances Effectiveness of Omeprazole in Indomethacin-Induced Gastric Injury Mice via Nrf2 Activation and Vagus Nerve Conduction.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture combined with omeprazole more effectively heals drug-induced stomach damage in mice than omeprazole alone.

mind_body.title: Application of Affective Touch in Patients With Advanced Cancer: Effects on Existential Distress, Pain, and Quality of Life.
mind_body.summary: Affective touch, a gentle hands-on therapy, reduced existential distress, pain, and improved quality of life in advanced cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of Mindfulness-Based Art Therapy for Oncology Nurses: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based art therapy reduces psychological stress in oncology nurses, improving their wellbeing and patient care quality.

mind_body.title: Acupoint catgut embedding ameliorates laparotomy-induced cognitive decline in aged mice by restoring gut microbiota.
mind_body.summary: Acupoint catgut embedding treatment reduced post-surgery cognitive decline in elderly mice by restoring healthy gut bacteria.

mind_body.title: Effects of manual acupuncture on microglial polarization and the Sirt1/NF-κB pathway in a rat model of post-stroke depression.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may treat post-stroke depression by reducing brain inflammation through immune cell regulation.

mind_body.title: Optimizing Postoperative Analgesia After Perianal Abscess Surgery Using Ultrasound-Guided Pudendal Nerve Block Combined with Wrist-Ankle Acupuncture: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Ultrasound-guided nerve blocks combined with acupuncture effectively reduced pain after perianal abscess surgery compared to standard treatment alone.

mind_body.title: Developing and Evaluating an Inpatient Caregiver Support Program: Feasibility, Acceptability, and Perceived Impact.
mind_body.summary: A hospital program providing emotional support and guidance to family caregivers of seriously ill patients proved feasible, acceptable, and beneficial.
